Star Wars - Shadows of the Empire.name: Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire
Star Wars - Shadows of the Empire.summary: As Luke Skywalker and the Rebel Alliance struggle to defeat Darth Vader and the Empire, a new threat arises. Dark Prince Xizor aspires to take Darth Vader's place at the Emperor's side. As Dash Rendar, it's up to you to protect Luke and help the Alliance. May the Force be with you!
